Are you looking for standard services? They can probably provide that here. Are you looking for specialists? Then look elsewhere. That will save you a lot of disappointment and money.

My Pomeranian was opened up for a hemorrhoid; she had two small holes in her belly. I was super happy that she could be helped, but not happy with the payment, certainly not with the aftercare. I had to pay well over two thousand euros. Two days later, my little dog was panting and making a rumbling sound. I called the emergency service with the whole story; I could come in, but I had to pay 300 euros, even though I feel this falls under your clinic's aftercare. Besides that, I think she should have come to you for a check-up. That was possible, but then you have to pay for that again, and for a follow-up check here, it costs money all over again. I really wonder now: is this a loving clinic for animals or a conveyor belt that wants to make money very quickly? When you pay so much money for your animal, and not even two days have passed, you can come in, but then you have to open your wallet again. Here, it's cutting it open and figuring things out further, not looking further at the wound. And if complications arise, you just have to pay again. I find this truly scandalous.

Good experience. Our puppy had elbow surgery here. Everything is explained well. And you can always call with questions or if you have any doubts about anything. They provide excellent support. Very friendly and caring. We visited for the last time today and they checked everything thoroughly and provided explanations in case anything comes up. Truly a very animal-friendly medical center. Top notch.

Very kind and professional doctors. Our cat underwent a very difficult mastectomy and tumor removal surgery that our own vet didn't dare attempt. The surgeon, Mike, did a truly wonderful job. After almost a month, our cat is completely himself again and even more lively than right before the surgery. Thank you!!

Never go here with your critically ill animal!! Had a totally uninterested emergency vet on the phone regarding a critically ill dog. Told me to just call my own vet the next day. Result: the dog suffered unnecessarily, ultimately leading to euthanasia. Shameful for the profession! And no decency to respond to my complaint either. Finally a response after a week. And lying, too. Horror clinic!!

My dog ​​Goro and I were referred by our veterinarian.
We were looked after wonderfully by the surgery team.
Even though not everything went according to plan, nothing was too much trouble; they were very helpful and there for me and Goro.
Now I have my buddy back and am very grateful to the doctors.
Kind regards, Chantal and Goro

We have had to visit the MCD multiple times with our dog Bibi over the past month, and Bibi also had to undergo surgery. The veterinarians are professional, friendly, and always willing to answer all your questions. We had a very good experience at this medical center and would absolutely recommend this place to other pet owners.

We were so sad when our dog's paw hurt after taking a tumble. McD, among other things, put a plate in his paw. They are energetic and professional, and—also very important to us—extremely kind to our scared dog, but especially to his owners. A beautifully decorated bandage, a card, and a hug were given on our last visit. Our dog still needs to take it easy, but he's improving. I'm so happy with the orthopedic care from McD!

Booked us in for the wrong exam and then simply sent us away saying they don’t do the exam we need so they cannot help.

My dog suddenly lost her vision so time is of the essence but the assistant could not care less.

When I emailed these exact words: “your  negligence and poor communication has cost us precious time” the floor manager emailed me to say this is unacceptable and I am no longer welcome ever again.

Maybe they should consider a career change.

Our beagle was suffering from a neck problem. We were referred to this veterinary clinic by our veterinarian, Rijnoever.
Our dog received excellent care, and we were given good advice on how best to help her.

All information regarding costs is clearly explained in advance so that you won't be faced with any surprises.
All the staff are very dedicated to the animals.

Sunday night we came with our 4 kittens urgently o... Sunday evening 3 kittens were allowed to go home again and now I can pick up the last kitten I am so grateful to you because of you our kittens are still here 🙏🙏🙏 sweet staff clear explanation and they keep you well informed …

We had multiple surgeries performed on our Labrador and British Shorthair by Mike and his team. Tumors were neatly removed from our Labrador. A nose correction on our British Shorthair due to a flat, small nose was also done fantastically. Mike and his team are true professionals with a great love for animals. Clear communication and good aftercare. Many thanks from us!

I contacted them a few weeks ago.
Unfortunately, the veterinary nurse was probably having a bad day, so I hung up.
I called Zwanenburg and was treated so well and helpfully.

Terrible attitude of people at the reception at the clinic! We paid 1000 euros for the examination! They prescribed us medications and didn’t say how much to give them! I called and wrote 50 letters to get an answer on how many days to give the medications! No one answered. I called and they promised to call me back and no one called. I wrote that my cat had diarrhea and that it hadn’t gone away for 2 weeks, but they didn’t care, they didn’t register the situation at all. Our appointment was delayed by 1.5 hours!!!!! As a result, they said that they were refusing to provide me with services because my communication wasn’t suitable for them!!! They didn’t answer a single letter. They have no right to prescribe medications and not say how many days to give them. This is a terrible clinic that will take a lot of money from you and then will not answer a single question.

My puppy Roosje had broken her right front paw, and it was a complex fracture. There was even an orthopedist who advised having her paw amputated.

Thanks to the highly skilled surgeon and specialists at the MCD, her paw has been saved and she can use it fully, without a trace of lameness.

I was able to watch the entire operation from the room next to the operating room, and that was a very pleasant experience for me.

There are very nice people working here who are ready to help your pet and you with advice and practical assistance.

Thank you so much, everyone.
I just called and was first in line and was pushed away so quickly. My dog ​​is in a lot of pain in his legs and it's Sunday, so surely you can't just click me away on this day.
They answer very late, and nothing is taken care of. I do not recommend it; it is a waste of time. Find another emergency doctor.
Very good experiences with the orthopedics and physio. They provide good information and really pay attention to your dog. Super sweet!

Our dog, Tommie, is recovering from a herniated disc in his neck. Two months ago, he was temporarily paralyzed. Thanks to plenty of rest and the excellent care of Louise, the orthopedic surgeon, Tommie can walk again. He's still a little wobbly, but we're happy with his progress.

Today, our Bullmastiff Banjer (80 kg) underwent surgery with Mike for an infection in his paw pad. What an incredibly friendly and caring team!

We've had previous experience with a university hospital in Utrecht, where the staff were also friendly, but here in Amsterdam, they truly surpassed that. Because Banjer doesn't get along well with other dogs, we were allowed to use the back hallway without any problems. The explanation was clear, and we were allowed to stay with him until he was put to sleep. Afterward, we were kept well-informed and were able to pick him up again in the afternoon.

Now there's a follow-up care program that will require us to travel from Noordwijk to Amsterdam a few times a week, but we're looking forward to that with confidence. It gives us great confidence in the care provided, and we hope Banjer makes a speedy recovery.

Unfortunately, our little 10-week-old kitten Poppy already had a broken leg. We were referred to MCD. The staff were all so lovely, and Poppy showed her best side. Fortunately, her recovery went well, and she doesn't need to come back. Thank you very much for the good care.

Greetings from Poppy
Our dog underwent a TPLO operation here. We are more than satisfied with the care provided. We also called several times afterwards with questions and received excellent assistance.

Our Havanese, Puck, wasn't feeling well two weeks ago and had to vomit. Nothing unusual in itself, but when I felt her belly, I found it very hard. Since it was Friday and we didn't want to start the weekend that way, we quickly went to our vet. X-rays and ultrasounds were taken, and something large was discovered in her abdomen, probably near the liver. She referred us to MCD.
...and thank goodness...!!!

After CT scans, it was discovered that—as surgeon Mike called it—there was a "spectacular" tumor on her kidney, not the liver.
This tumor was pushing her intestines aside.
It was quite frightening, but there was warm and reassuring attention for both Puck and us. The following Thursday, Puck underwent surgery. It was wonderful that Mike kept us informed when the surgery started and when it was finished. The removed kidney and a biopsy of the peritoneum were sent to the pathologist. Mike removed the tumor with great skill. Puck was stable during the surgery, and so we were able to take her home that evening. The nurse gave her to us with the words, "She's the sweetest and cutest dog today." A large gash from top to bottom on her belly, a romper to protect her abdomen, and painkillers for the next few days.
The loving care and attention from everyone at MCD Amsterdam were so good for both Puck and us.
Surgeon Mike called again today with the pathologist's results and asked, "How is our child doing?" It's wonderful to know that someone understands that this little one is like a child to us.
Puck is doing great. She's a happy, playful dog.
Despite the fact that it was cancer, which has been removed, we can enjoy Puck for many years to come.
Thank you, Mike and everyone there, for your support and the loving care for Puck.

The veterinarian Judith was rude. She acted as if she doesn’t have any empathy in a rude and accusing manner (but the other veterinarians were really sweet). I don’t recommend going here for emergencies.

I can’t thank enough for the care they gave my dog. We first went in on an urgent appointment because he had a painful abscess in his anal glands. From the very beginning, the team was incredibly attentive, compassionate, and professional. They explained everything clearly, reassured us, and made sure my dog was comfortable.

When it became clear that surgery was needed, they continued to provide excellent support every step of the way. The surgery went very well, and my dog was looked after with such dedication during his recovery.

I truly appreciate the quality of service, kindness, and genuine care they showed us from the first urgent visit through to the surgery and follow-up. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinary team.
Friendly people, clean facility

Our dog needed emergency surgery at the MCD. I arrived in a terrible panic because our dog had a ruptured gallbladder and fluid in his abdomen, and we had already been warned that it could be a fairly risky operation. Dr. Mike Hubers explained to us clearly and calmly what was going to happen, acted quickly to help our dog, and called us immediately after the surgery to let us know that everything had gone well. We also received a photo of our dog at the shelter that evening, which made us feel much more at ease. Dr. Mike has also been incredibly involved during the aftercare process – quick and clear communication, genuinely interested in how our dog was doing, good communication with our local veterinary clinic, and making the right choices at every step of this process. We are incredibly grateful that our dog was saved this evening at the MCD, so that we can hopefully enjoy his company for many years to come. A huge thank you to everyone who took good care of Drako during his visit and for thinking along with us during this process!

Our dog Soof had surgery at MCD. Nothing but compliments for everyone there. So kind to us and the dog, too. From surgery to recovery.
It made something very unpleasant quite bearable.

Our rescue dog had a bad accident before we adopted her. We therefore wanted to check if her hip is in a good condition nowadays and make sure we give her the best chance of a long and painfree life.
The orthopaedic department was amazing! Extremely knowledgeable and even made our anxious dog super comfortable. During our physio appointments, she was so excited to see her therapist and do some training - normally she is scared of new people and environments. You can tell how empathetic they are, with us AND our dog!
Thank you so much for your care and help with our Keela!

I ended up at the medical center (orthopedics department) with my dog ​​for emergency surgery. Even though it was an emergency, the staff were patient and compassionate. They are very knowledgeable and give good advice. They saved my dog. 🫶 …

If I could give 10 stars, I would. Five years ago, we sadly had to put our 9-month-old kitten to sleep here. We experienced so much compassion at this clinic. Now, our cat Nikos had to be urgently admitted to the MCD. What passionate, professional, and kind people work here. Not only kind to your pet, but also to the owner, because yes, I was quite sad. I know my cat is getting the best possible treatment here!

Last week, I called the clinic around 10 p.m. because my dog ​​had an acute anal gland abscess. This means the anal gland is about to burst. It's incredibly painful for dogs, but they didn't consider it an urgent matter. I wasn't allowed to come in. This meant he could stay overnight and go to my vet the next day.

They even said "have a nice evening" and hung up while I was still talking.

After much pleading, I was allowed to go to the emergency clinic in Amstelveen.
There, the anal gland had already burst before they could begin the procedure.
So this was definitely an urgent matter.
It's outrageous that they think you should just let your pet suffer all night.

Last Sunday, sadly, we had to rush to the MDC in Amsterdam with a critically ill 14-year-old Golden Retriever. We were helped by a young, kind, skilled, and respectful vet, who, together with us, guided the dog peacefully and lovingly across the rainbow bridge. A staff member even helped place the dog in the back of our car. The help, the humanity, and the sweet card sent home a few days later helped make the grief over our Quincy a little more bearable. Kudos to the MCD team. You are the best!

Yesterday we took our dog Ziva to you for an emergency.
You helped us tremendously.
The doctor who helped us was super sweet and very calm.
We received excellent care.
Fortunately, Ziva is doing a bit better now. Thanks again for the excellent care.
Not satisfied with communication and service!!

The emergency clinic that was actually reachable and received us after calling two others immediately responded: "Just come here." And we were helped so well with our cat's stalled labor. While the surgeon was on his way for the caesarean section, our cat started pushing again on her own. She was allowed to finish the delivery in a consultation room there, with our support. The last kitten was having a very hard time and was stillborn; here too, your veterinarian and the rest of the team provided full assistance. This kitten made it and is doing great. Hugely grateful for a wonderful and dedicated team! The costs were very reasonable, even though the caesarean section would have been very pricey; we were grateful that they were there to help us. Highly recommended for emergencies!

Six weeks ago, my dachshund had surgery for a radius curvis. We were able to get the surgery the very day after the consultation, which we were very happy about because Cookie was limping badly. It's nice that you can watch during the operation, and what a top-notch surgeon. The specialists were also super friendly, took their time explaining things, and they have so much love for their patients. The only thing I have to mention is that the price you are quoted does not include VAT. As a result, almost €400 was added to our bill after what was said during the consultation. And the prices are already quite high. We went for a follow-up consultation today, and fortunately, it looked very good. Surgery successful 🙏🩵

My little red and white cat, Billy, came limping downstairs in January, meowing loudly; she was collapsing on her hind legs and walking with bow legs. After several visits to the vet, who was unable to make a diagnosis, I was referred with her to the MCD, Department of Orthopedics. The first appointment was a very positive experience, during which the veterinarian, Kaat Houben, took ample time for us and diagnosed Billy with patellar luxation in both knees. She required two surgeries. The costs were discussed very clearly. Billy underwent surgery on her left leg on March 22, and after several weeks of crate rest, her right leg was finally operated on June 6. After both surgeries, the surgeon personally came to pick me up from the waiting room to report on the course of the operations. That gave a very pleasant feeling. Dr. Roelof Maarschalkerweerd and his team performed both surgeries and did a truly fantastic job; the scars have healed beautifully, and Billy is now, after many weeks of crate rest, cautiously parading through the living room. She thinks it is wonderful that she can walk again and even ran cautiously for a moment. Step by step, in consultation with veterinarian Kaat Houben, I am building up Billy's physiotherapy so that she can soon go outside again and play, run, and chase flies.
I am incredibly grateful for all the excellent care Billy received from the entire team in the orthopedics department. The love for animals, the aftercare, and especially the personal attention moved me deeply. What a golden team at the MCD! From doctors to surgeons to assistants to receptionists, everyone was truly very kind, understanding, and helpful. On behalf of myself and Billy, thank you very much for your good care, kindness, and support. Billy was never happy to go back to the hospital, but she is now clearly showing through her behavior that she knows it was for her own good and well-being. A cup for you from a grateful Billy.

Kind regards,

Corina Driessen
Fast, professional

Our dog, Uzi, has severe arthritis and underwent surgery on both elbow joints at the MCD. What an incredibly professional and friendly team! Uzi was successfully treated. Despite the unpleasant experience, our dog walks into the MCD with a wagging tail.

Recently, my Pomeranian, Cooper, underwent surgery for a unilateral perineal hernia at the Veterinary Medical Center. From the very first moment, we felt very welcome.
The staff at the reception desk and on the phone were exceptionally friendly and empathetic. We immediately felt that there was attention and care for both Cooper and for us as his owners. Every question was answered with great patience and understanding.
Our special thanks go to surgeon Mike and resident Stef. They really took the time to explain everything to us clearly and understandably: from what the surgery would entail to the aftercare required at home. Their explanation was clear and reassuring, so we knew what to expect and felt well prepared.
The support after the surgery was also excellent. We received a comprehensive aftercare letter and could always call if we had any doubts.
In short: we are very satisfied with the care, the personal contact, and the clear communication. Our compliments to the team!
Clear, calm and extremely helpful advice from the front desk when I rang up with a concern about blue algal poisoning. No follow-up was needed but the assistance was invaluable.

Action taken incredibly quickly after the CT scan. I was able to get an appointment for surgery the very next week. This has gone well so far. Highly specialized. I was able to watch, how fantastic! I was close to my sweet dog. How valuable. Wonderful staff and friendly assistance. Now waiting for my sweet Kyra to wake up. We are immensely grateful!

My chihuahua Bibi had surgery for a prolapsed palate performed by Mike Hubers a few weeks ago.

Bibi has had severe shortness of breath since she was very young; we went to the vet frequently with these symptoms and tried everything.
At the beginning of this summer, the symptoms only worsened, to the point where I couldn't even walk her in the nice weather.

We then went to the MCD and indicated that such an operation was possible.

We took this up immediately, and now, a few weeks after the surgery, I have a completely different dog back. She plays, she walks with a lead, she doesn't snore anymore, and most importantly, she has lost almost 1 kilo.

That is quite a weight loss for such a small dog.
I am so happy that Mike was able to help her like this!

Super clean and friendly staff.
My French bulldog needed knee surgery.

Dear Eva and everyone who helped us in December.

Unfortunately, our Puck didn't make it, but you were so wonderful.
Everything we wanted for her was no problem for you. We feel like you tried everything and are very grateful.

I took my dog Kikka to Medisch Centrum voor Dieren after being referred by our local vet. She had been struggling with two of her toes for a very long time, and we weren't sure what was wrong. From the very beginning, the team at MCD gave Kikka the best care and looked at her situation holistically. What we first thought might be SLO turned out to be Squamous Cell Carcinoma.

A very special thanks to Sara Muñoz Declara for her thorough investigation and care, and to Mike Hubers for performing the surgery. Kikka might be two toes lighter, but she's a hundred times happier now.

If your furry kid has a persistent issue and you don't know where else to turn, ask your vet for a referral to Medisch Centrum voor Dieren. They truly go above and beyond.

Last night, our cat Aslan suddenly felt very unwell. Fortunately, we were able to get an appointment at MCD quickly. He was thoroughly examined by a caring and friendly veterinarian. When his condition had not improved after five hours, we were able to call again for advice and make a second appointment; that also went smoothly and pleasantly. Ultimately, Aslan recovered just before we left, and we were able to decide, in consultation, to leave him at home, which was very nice for him.

We have also received good help several times in the past. One of our other cats had to be hospitalized for a longer period at the time, and we were kept well informed throughout. The communication was clear, friendly, and caring. Fortunately, he has also fully recovered.

Unfortunately, we also had to say goodbye to our cat Tijger once, who could not be saved due to heart failure. In that difficult situation as well, the veterinarians took ample time for him and for us. We received honest answers to our questions, including “What would you do if it were your cat?” It was an honest and compassionate conversation that gave us a lot of support. The aftercare following his passing was also caring and careful. In short: at MCD, there are wonderful people who have knowledge, patience, and a heart for animals (and their owners). We are grateful for the good care our cats receive here time and time again.

In early May, my cat came home with a strange paw.
The next day, it turned out her metatarsals were broken, and Bloem needed emergency surgery.

I was kept well informed and was able to pick her up again quickly.
We returned every week for the bandage change.
Now Bloem is allowed to gradually start putting more weight on her leg again.
Thanks to the excellent care from everyone at the MCD, Bloem is almost ready to go outside again!

Thank you!

I am coming to this clinic with my third dog. I have always been satisfied. Very satisfied with the expertise and customer-friendliness. You can ask them anything and stay with them throughout! It was very nice that I could see Maya all day long, even during the surgery. In the photo, she was still sleeping off her anesthesia in the recovery room 🫶🏼

We received incredibly good help from Stef and Mike. We were able to get an appointment at MCD quickly. Venz was in good hands with you!!

After careful consultation with the assistant, it wasn't necessary to come in at night. Contrary to what you read here and there, they're truly there for the animal's well-being! Five stars ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️
